7839: Lie on your back with arms straight above you and knees bent at 90 degrees.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Lower one arm and the opposite leg toward the floor.

Pedal backward in a smooth circle.
Keep your lower back pressed down.
Continue for a set time or reps.

Raise your top arm up toward the ceiling.
Rotate and thread your arm under your torso.
Open back up and raise the arm again.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.

Move quickly, hopping or shifting your hands and feet.

Grip the handles overhead with your elbows pointing up.
Extend your arms until they are almost straight.
Squeeze your triceps at the top.

Pin your upper arms to your sides.
Straighten your elbows to kick the weights back.

Hold a dumbbell in the free hand with your upper arm against your side.

Push the plate out explosively with both arms.
Pull the plate back to your chest with control.
